searchText: There's no way to return that because the slashing penalty is not known on a per-block basis. You only know how much a validator was slashed after a period passes and the correlation penalty is applied. good to know, thank you. Would it make sense to return it after the period? someone commented on the issue that it would be possible <a:thinkRoll:585724848823599105> I think it becomes hard for the node to start tracking these things on a per-validator basis. I am not sure what the consumer of this info is, but I suspect it would mostly be you guys running services. In which case I think it's better if you do grab this info from the state transition function and store this block per-block in your own custom dbase other clients may disagree here though Everything is possible, I just don't think these things should be specified <@412614104222531604> I'm in the process of testing some of my changes here, but if you're interested in trying out authtoken stuff it's on this PR right now for prysm https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/13747 I don't think <@1035747431461167125> knows the complexity of what he wrote there 😄 . I suspect he's only talking about the initial slashing reward that is in fact the whistleblower reward given to the proposer. This can be done in a per-block basis. For the actual correlation penalty I think it would be much more complex I'll take what I can get 🙂 will check later this week thank you! Yea I was talking about the per-block basis😅 the slashing penalty over time will be hard to calculate I’ll edit my comment to make it less confusing will check later this week thank you!

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: I think it becomes hard for the node to start tracking these things on a per-validator basis. I am not sure what the consumer of this info is, but I suspect it would mostly be you guys running services. In which case I think it's better if you do grab this info from the state transition function and store this block per-block in your own custom dbase
